title: The Equality Cases for the Grone-Merris-Bai Theorem
summary: The Grone--Merris inequality, conjectured by Grone and Merris~(1994) and first proved by Bai~(2011), states that for every graph $G$ of order $n$ and every $1\le k\le n$, $\sum_{i=1}^kλ_i(G)\le\sum_{i=1}^k d_i^*(G)$, where $λ_1\ge\cdots\geλ_n$ are the Laplacian eigenvalues and $d_1^*\ge\cdots\ge d_n^*$ is the conjugate degree sequence. In this paper we determine exactly when equality holds.
